verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes documents point-in-time snapshots of sandbox directories stored in R2 that can be restored later, which covers the core snapshot/restore idea. The scope is directory-level, not a full sandbox snapshot (processes, memory, whole machine state), and nothing shows forking new sandboxes from a snapshot. Missing for 10: full-sandbox (not just directory) snapshot, documented forking of new sandboxes from a snapshot, detailed snapshot API docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can snapshot a sandbox and later restore or fork new sandboxes from that snapshot

citations.quote: Create point-in-time snapshots of directories and restore them from R2.
